topic: Live traffic filtering discrepancies in analytics
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on a discrepancy where live traffic metrics appear higher than total traffic when filtered for the current day. It was noted that the live traffic metric might not correctly account for applied filters (such as city selection) in real-time reporting, leading to confusing data for users and clients. A suggestion was made that the bot should provide a task number or ticket ID in its response regarding these discrepancies.
decisions: Implement filtering logic for live traffic metrics.
action_items: Investigate why real-time data does not respect applied filters (e.g., city selection) within the bot's reporting mechanism.
